build_hf_gpt2_model: build a HuggingFaceGPT2LanguageModel instance using build_model with args and task
create_gpt2_decoder: create a HuggingFaceGPT2Decoder with GPT2Config and GPT2LMHeadModel from transformers
run_forward_pass: run the forward method on HuggingFaceGPT2Decoder with prev_output_tokens to get lm_logits
extract_gpt2_features: extract features from prev_output_tokens using HuggingFaceGPT2Decoder extract_features method
configure_gpt2_architecture: configure GPT2 model architecture using default_architecture hf_gpt2_medium hf_gpt2_large or hf_gpt2_xl
